shortlist: Nasal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma with NK-cell marker positivity

shortlist.label: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: EBV-positive, CD138-positive, and CD56-positive, consistent with NK/T-cell lymphoma

shortlist.label: Nasal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma with NK-cell marker positivity
Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: EBV-positive and presence of a large polypoid mass, although less common

shortlist.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD138-positive and EBV-positive, although less typical presentation

shortlist.label: Nasal type T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches clinical presentation and T-cell lymphoma subtype

raw.rationale: The presence of a large polypoid mass in the nasal cavity, CD138 and CD56 positivity, and EBV positivity are consistent with Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma. The gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci on fluorescence in situ hybridization also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Nasal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma with NK-cell marker positivity
rejected.why: This is essentially a description of Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, making it redundant

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
rejected.why: Typically associated with a more systemic disease and often linked to Epstein-Barr virus in the context of immunodeficiency, which is not indicated here

rejected.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
rejected.why: Usually CD20 positive and associated with immunodeficiency or immunosuppression, which does not match the provided key facts

rejected.label: Nasal type T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The provided immunophenotype (CD138 and CD56 positive, CD20 and PAX5 negative) and EBV positivity are more characteristic of NK/T-cell lymphoma than T-cell lymphoma
